title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at S74w16860 Janesville Road, in Muskego, Wisconsin, as the "Colonel Hans Christian Heg Post Office".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at S74w16860 Janesville Road, in Muskego, Wisconsin, as the Colonel Hans Christian Heg Post Office.

summary.headline: Congress renamed a Postal Service facility in Muskego, Wisconsin, after Colonel Hans Christian Heg.
summary.what_it_does: This law names the U.S. Postal Service building at S74w16860 Janesville Road in Muskego, Wisconsin, the Colonel Hans Christian Heg Post Office. Heg was a Norwegian-born Union Army colonel in the Civil War. The change is only a name change and does not alter postal services, rules, or staffing.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on November 25, 2024, and the new name applies from that date.
